name: Table converter
summary: Convert table between CSV, Markdown, JSON
author: friday-core
description: Converts a table between CSV (or TSV), a Markdown table and JSON (a list of objects). The source format is detected; say the target (csv, tsv, markdown, json). Quotes and commas in CSV cells and pipes in Markdown cells are escaped, number-looking JSON values stay numbers and a leading zero (007) stays text.
